article.title: The Flaky Test Death Loop: Why AI Coding Agents Vaporize Working Code Over CI Jitter

data.text:
Autonomous coding agents have a fatal blind spot: 1% CI jitter. When an agent hits an unrelated socket timeout, it doesn't hit rerun—it panics, slaps sleep(5) everywhere, and vaporizes working code.
